primary_metric: unweighted arithmetic mean of per-image native macro IoU across the nine named ROIs, one fixed RGB conversion (equal 9+19)
secondary_metrics: CPU wall time including method preprocessing and native projection, excluding shared input loading, compression and scoring
frozen_inputs: virchow2-expanded-inputs-2026-10-17; every original RGB representation, original/completed coarse mask and tissue support must retain its SHA256

initial_hypotheses.E01: Robust full-covariance evidence: use all known coarse tissue with continuously weighted tile-center evidence, no fixed training margin and no hard seed points.
initial_hypotheses.E02: Bayesian colour lattice: learn multimodal class likelihoods in quantized converted-RGB space, regularize sparse colour counts and classify the whole tissue.
initial_hypotheses.E03: Guided posterior regression: edge-aware local linear regression of class evidence, replacing iterative segmentation with box-filter sufficient statistics.
initial_hypotheses.E04: Screened region diffusion: solve a sparse Laplacian system with soft coarse observations and RGB likelihoods, allowing all regions to change.
initial_hypotheses.E05: Nonlocal evidence graph: connect distant regions with similar converted RGB as well as adjacent regions, then solve harmonic class competition.
initial_hypotheses.E06: Tile-rank constraints: treat a coarse label as the most prevalent class of a tile, rather than the label of every pixel; minimally adjust pixel evidence to satisfy that inequality.

stopping_rule: Develop in documented rounds. After initial hypotheses, pursue genuinely distinct responses to observed failure modes. Stop after two consecutive rounds produce no new accuracy/speed Pareto improvement (accuracy tolerance 0.001 mean IoU, speed tolerance 5%), or when remaining ideas need different RGB inputs/new external supervision. This is a finite exploratory search, not a claim that innovation is exhausted.
selection: Report the Pareto frontier. Prefer the fastest method within 0.002 mean IoU of the highest development score. Freeze the final method and parameters before full-corpus scoring; no per-image or per-conversion method selection.
evaluation_scope: Nine development ROIs are tuning data. Full corpus contains 149 ROIs; report the nine separately from the other 140, which are additional evaluation cases, not a pristine external test. Coarse labels originate from the same references; report controlled refinement, not independent supervised classifier generalization.
prediction_policy: No fine-reference file access during predictions. All detected tissue receives a known coarse class; background is removed after segmentation. Quality support remains the unchanged original reference >0, including false tissue-detector exclusions.
runtime_policy: Chiamaka CPU, at most three low-priority processes, two numerical threads each; no new encoder inference or GPU work. Retained comparators and novel methods use the same common input and are timed including their own preprocessing. Store repeated development timings; shared computations must not give a later method free preprocessing.
